# hands/bounty

bounties Teeny opens, judges and pays.

## How to call it

Run it from the repository root with your shell (exec) tool: `hands/bounty <verb> [flags]`.

- A verb that takes a body reads one JSON object from stdin. Everything else is flags.
- It prints one JSON object on stdout. Exit 0 is success. Exit 2 is a refusal by a rule, the guard or a cap: read the `rule` and `reason`, and do not retry it unchanged. Any other exit is an error.
- Secrets belong to the hand; you never see them and never pass one.
- The hand runs the guard, its caps and `DRY_RUN` itself. `DRY_RUN` is on unless the box turned it off; under it an acting verb checks every rule and sends nothing. Do not try to go around the hand, and do not look for another way to do what it refused.

## Side effects

- Acting (side effects in the world, each goes through the guard and the caps): pick
- Job (writes state or calls the core): entries ID; claim; pay ID; pay-due
- Operator only (never call): open; link ID [--x POST] [--moltbook POST]
- Read only: list [--status S], get ID; announcements

## Verbs

| Verb | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `open` | O | `{title, rules, prize_usdc, deadline, channels: [x, moltbook]}`. |
| `list [--status S]`, `get ID` | R | Bounties (statuses `open`, `picked`, `claimed`, `paid`, `in_doubt`), one with its entry counts and winner. |
| `announcements` | R | What the playbooks owe a post for: `open` (no tagged post yet), `to_pick` (past the deadline, with the entries that are neither late nor held), `paid` (a prize whose signature no post carries yet). |
| `entries ID` | J | Links the bounty's posts (Teeny's earliest X post carrying the tag; a Moltbook post whose title carries it). |
| `pick` | A | `{bounty_id, entry_id, reasons, text}`, after the deadline, for an entry neither late, held nor Teeny's. |
| `claim` | J | `{bounty_id, address, source_id}`: a collected reply by the winning account, on the winning entry's channel, that carries the address. |
| `pay ID` | J | Once claimed and public for `BOUNTY_CHALLENGE_HOURS` (12): the wallet's `pay` with purpose `bounty`, which checks it all again. |
| `pay-due` | J | Every bounty past its deadline: `entries`, then `pay` when claimed. |
| `link ID [--x POST] [--moltbook POST]` | O | Names the bounty's posts by hand. |

Kinds: R = read: no side effect beyond its read cache; A = acting: posts, sends, pays or opens something in the world; O = operator-only: the operator runs it, never you; J = job: writes state or calls the core, says nothing to anyone; scheduled jobs run it, you do not.

Verbs named in the hand's source: `announcements`, `claim`, `entries`, `get`, `link`, `list`, `open`, `pay`, `pay-due`, `pick`.

Flags named in the hand's source: `--moltbook`, `--status`, `--x`.

For one verb's exact flags, run `hands/bounty <verb> --help` (never put a VAR= in front of a command: the shell refuses it, and DRY_RUN is not yours to set). The full account is in docs/hands.md.
